source.title: Lee's Ultimate Test Quest... of Doom!
source.description:
Bah! What do think this is, some kind of Test Quest? I be there even be typos in it!

If ya be thinkin' my quest is goin' ta be easy, then ya got another thing coming!

Kill me ten sheep (1933) and don't come back until you do!
source.objective:
Kill 6 sheep for Benny and then run like hell!

Just kidding... about the running part.
